visual_action: A static image of Donald Trump and another man in a formal setting is shown with text overlays. This cuts to a static, high-angle shot of the House of Representatives floor during a vote, with a vote tally overlaid on the screen.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in the initial photograph and his name is featured prominently in the on-screen text: "GOP-CONTROLLED HOUSE PASSES TRUMP'S BUDGET BILL".

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "GOP-CONTROLLED HOUSE" and the vote tally on the subsequent screen lists votes for "REPUBLICAN" members.

cast.name: unnamed politician
cast.evidence: An unidentified man in a suit and glasses is pictured standing next to Donald Trump in the opening image.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The vote tally screen lists the votes for the "DEMOCRATIC" party.

on_screen_text.text: GOP-CONTROLLED HOUSE PASSES TRUMP'S BUDGET BILL
Trump's budget will cause $1T in Medicaid cuts, kick 17 million Americans off their health care, and grant tax cuts to millionaires and billionaires.
ON MOTION TO CONCUR IN THE SENATE AMENDMENT

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue or narration; the audio is purely instrumental music.
audio_music: A dramatic and somber instrumental string track plays throughout, creating a serious and ominous tone.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced video consisting of a cut from one static image to another static shot, both with text overlays.
central_claim: The GOP-controlled House has passed a budget proposed by Donald Trump that will cut Medicaid, remove 17 million Americans from healthcare, and give tax cuts to millionaires and billionaires.
intended_effect: To cause alarm and anger towards Donald Trump and the Republican party by highlighting the negative consequences of their proposed budget.
